notes:
A tidier, more consistent window, from a full review of every page.

- Every theme now colours its selected tabs, chips and switches with its own accent (Sunrise is orange throughout), and off switches are a quiet grey. In Light and Sunrise the filter chips are no longer heavy dark pills.
- Section headings are plain sentence case on every page, and details such as a date or a place sit on their own line instead of after a "·".
- Reminders: the page starts with the typing box; editing a reminder opens the form in place of its card; "Skip this one" is a small link so every card keeps one row of buttons; "Waits for you" is gone and "Brief" reads "Shows briefly"; deleting asks "Delete this reminder?".
- Overview: the Due now panel puts your answer first; the update notice is a slim strip; an empty day doesn't repeat itself.
- Sidebar: Pause, Test reminder and Preview reminder sit in a neat column, and in a narrow window Pause stays reachable from the icon rail.
- Settings: Sound and Quiet hours have their own cards, labels no longer repeat themselves, Quiet hours Start and End sit side by side, and button rows line up.
- Appearance: the Match system tile is fixed, and Donna's size preview shows how tall she'll be.
- Calendars, History and About: shorter wording, clearer Clear history and Clear local data actions, a compact What's new, and one Support card in About.
- Donna is sharp at every size: at 1.5× and above she now uses double-resolution footage (3× is as sharp as the original videos allow).
- Her idle loop no longer fades at the join: it now loops on matching moments of the footage.
- Overview > Upcoming lists only what is still to come; today's done and missed reminders are in History, with a "See History" link under the list. Calendars on Overview is one line with Manage.
- Dates read the same everywhere ("Today at 4:00 PM").
- Smaller touches: the Routines tab is titled Routines, battery limits save as you type, a page error shows a Reload card instead of a blank window, no text below 12 px, hover and press feedback that never sticks, a themed switch knob, one look for disabled controls, and the speech bubble no longer bounces.
